quote: Empathy, tolerance, and goodwill are inexplicably linked to our humanity. So are hatred, racism, and ill-will. What will we choose to be our legacy?
author: Rev. Randy Lewis
socialPost:
Let us choose to nurture empathy and goodwill, for these are the seeds of a legacy that uplifts humanity. Together, we can forge a future where love triumphs over hate.

https://blog.revrandylewis.com/our-collective-legacy/

#ChooseLove #LegacyOfGoodwill
